assessment: read-only source assessment; no workflow execution or remote consumer conformance proof

immutableSourceDispatch.reason: Installer jobs report github.sha, but this consumer accepts no expected Cadence candidate source or manifest digest and has no Cadence request adapter. Source equality cannot be enforced from a moving ref alone.

externalCorrelation.reason: Dispatch carries tag/platform/profile/manifestAsset, not Cadence attempt/correlation ID. Source-named manifests help manual recovery but do not provide the required dispatch acknowledgement and lost-ack protocol.

artifactProvenance.reason: Existing publisher compares recorded source/profile, downloaded installer byte count and SHA-256. Source-supported capability only; no artifact was downloaded in this assessment.

targetSerialization.reason: Metadata repository_dispatch uses a shared concurrency group, but builds use ref-scoped groups and landing deployment is a separate dispatch. End-to-end target-wide fencing for competing Cadence candidates is not demonstrated.

expectedPredecessorPromotion.reason: Metadata commits use branch-head CAS, but the coordinator reloads mutable origin/default branch and only checks package version; no expected advertised candidate or website predecessor is accepted.

siteReceipts.reason: Coordinator reports landing dispatch completion, not deployed site identity or exact live advertised artifact links.

branchVersionOwnership.reason: Do not promote a new release version on the publication branch while a prior version requires it; independent edits/commits in another worktree remain possible.

nextAction: Create a separately approved Boss release-consumer follow-up owned by boss-desktop/release to accept immutable candidate/source identity and correlation, enforce target and predecessor promotion, and return platform/metadata/deployed-site receipts. Keep automatic Cadence dispatch blocked until actual capability evidence exists.
